title: The Cat in the Hat
author: Dr. Seuss
summary: On a rainy day, two bored children are visited by a tall talking cat in a red-and-white hat who turns their house upside down with games and tricks. They must tidy up before their mother comes home.
readIf: you want rhyming, silly fun for a child learning to read.
skipIf: you want a quiet story, since the cat's chaos is loud and mischievous.
